title: AccountAnalysis V3
description: Deterministic reusable analysis for one normalized account snapshot.

analysis_id.description: Deterministic identifier derived from snapshot and rule version.

coverage.description: Collected and usable content counts plus missing data.

rankings.description: Content ranked by observed views with original metrics and URLs.

outliers.description: Account-relative view multiples when the comparable cohort is sufficient.

pillar_performance.description: Deterministic performance grouped by supplied semantic pillar labels.

funnel_signals.description: Observable attention, interaction, and action signals without causal interpretation.

claim_boundary.description: Claims supported or unsupported by this snapshot.
